mira: Quick — finalizing green-room protocol for Wed webinar at 11am PT. Need a short checklist + fallback flow for demo outages. Can we lock this down?

alex: Agenda locked. Need the exact demo-endpoint fallback commands and who confirms flip.

jamal: Making a one-pager for speakers with mic checks, visual cues, and a 30s hold script. Will share draft by EOD.

sara: Ops can run a full preflight at 10:15 PT. I can do a test push to staging model and verify KV cache priming.

ops-bot: reminder: Zoom link scheduled at 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z — recording enabled, waiting room off.

mira: @sara yes please. Also need a graceful fallback script if the primary instance saturates: 1) switch to lower-q model, 2) route to warm standby, 3) show cached condensed responses with a banner.

alex: For model switch we'll use this curl in sandbox — please validate: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"demo","model":"gpt-small-v2"}'`

jamal: Add these on-stage cue cards: "We are switching to condensed demo answers to keep latency low" and "Brief pause for system fallback (30s)". Keep language non-technical for audience.

sara: Scheduling a 10:15 full dry run (speakers + prod + ops). @mira can you confirm speaker availability now?

mira: Confirmed speakers: Priya, Thomas, Dana. Priya asked for a 1:1 mic check at 10:05.

alex: We'll run two demo endpoints: `primary` and `warm-standby`. Warm-standby config: `min_instances=1`, `quantized=true`, `region=us-west-2`. Ops please validate cost bump.

ops-bot: alert: on-call for Wed 11-12 PT is @kevin.

kevin: I'll be on Slack + pager. Rollback plan: if p50 latency > 3s for 2 continuous minutes, flip to cached responses and page the team. I'll post the runbook in #eng-oncall.

jamal: Drafting the green-room PDF now — will drop in #marketing-assets and share a short link in this thread when ready.

mira: Final asks before we close: add a single-line speaker-facing script for audio hiccups and a very short script they can read if answers are condensed. Example: "We're temporarily on condensed answers to keep things snappy — full examples in follow-up email." :thumbsup:

alex: Putting notes into the run-of-show doc: https://drive.google.com/placeholder-run-of-show — will update exact link after assets are uploaded.

sara: Lead routing note: if live attendees > 500, route demo signups to SDR queue `webinar-high`, else `webinar-regular`. Adding to post-demo automation.

mira: Great. Green-room meet at 9:50 PT. Thanks everyone — feel free to ping me with any last-minute blockers.
